[EVT-1] Mic Array Port Geometry and MEMS Alignment
Define port tube diameter (target 1.5 mm), minimum length, and centreline alignment tolerance to MEMS package port (±0.2 mm)
Specify protective mesh for each exterior port opening: 316 SS 400-mesh (35 µm aperture) for IP30 dust protection; confirm insertion loss ≤1 dB on mesh sample before committing to BOM.
Design gasket layer between array PCB and chassis wall to seal each port tube individually — prevents cross-talk between adjacent port cavities.
Specify silicone standoff material, stiffness, and placement to decouple array PCB from chassis; target standoff resonant frequency <30 Hz.
Confirm no rigid metal path exists between panel sub-PCBs and array PCB through the chassis structure.
Perform resonant mode analysis of base front lip (FEM or experimental modal analysis); confirm no chassis resonance in 100 Hz–4 kHz mic band.
Measure structure-borne noise floor on EVT-1 units: all internal components active, no external acoustic source, calibrated mic at array port position.
Collect minimum inputs before opening CAD:
Model two-part housing shell (top and bottom halves): internal cavity sized to PCB envelope + 3 mm clearance all faces; wall thickness 2.5 mm; no surface detailing or strain relief at this stage.
Open IEC C8 inlet cutout at confirmed position on housing end face; rectangular cutout matching C8 panel mount dimensions.
Open DC barrel jack cutout at confirmed position on opposite end face; circular cutout matching barrel jack body diameter.
Open cable exit hole on housing side face at confirmed diameter (cable OD + 0.5 mm clearance); straight through-hole, no strain relief geometry at this stage.
[NEED Confirming] [EVT-1] Acoustic Baffling Around Mic Array
Map reflection paths from parametric arrays to mic array via desk surface, monitor, and agent body; identify dominant reflection angles.
Specify absorptive foam strips on base front face adjacent to port array; define foam NRC, thickness, and bonding method.
Validate baffle effectiveness on EVT-1: measure masking wash level at mic array position with and without baffling; confirm >30 dB below voice level.
[EVT-1] Acoustic Side Baffle Design for Speaker Panel
Define baffle geometry on inner panel faces: angled profile to direct diffraction away from mic array; produce drawing with foam thickness and angle callouts.
Specify open-cell acoustic foam material for baffles; confirm NRC ≥0.85 at 1 kHz on production sample.
Confirm baffle edge clearance from nearest transducer element: minimum 15 mm to prevent diffraction interaction with array aperture.
Measure masking-wash buildup at agent ear plane on EVT-1 floor setup (16 units, Beacon-coordinated); confirm <3 dB above single-unit baseline.
Add 4 temporary snap-fit tabs at housing parting line to hold top and bottom halves together for RP-1 fit check; no production parting line geometry.
Export STL files for top half and bottom half; send to printer; confirm print starts by end of Day 3.
